scope: Independent read-only review of the existing full-engine high-note Saw baseline. No new audio rendering, optimizer, coefficient fit, spectral amplitude refit, DSP edits, staging or commit.

verification.method: Verified source/renderer/media/recipe/helper/result hashes, all ten raw sample extractions, saved fixed gains, direct waveform statistics, and elementary arithmetic over stored harmonic/alias measurements. Read estimator implementation; did not refit amplitudes or re-run optimizers.

provenance_review.finding: All retained DSP files match the original shipping checkpoint exactly. The copied renderer installs an empty default TimbreCalibration profile; its only renderer changes are that installation and an Engine type alias. Current Source/DSP plus RenderMidi differ only by reverbWetReturn 0.8 to 0.4 and comments.
provenance_review.dry_applicability: Renderer sets the patch then resets. Engine reset clears delay/FDN state and initializes reverbWetGain to zero for the disabled-reverb fixture. Note-only MIDI cannot enable effects. The current return constant is inactive here. This establishes dry-source applicability, not fresh current-binary PCM identity.
provenance_review.performance: Original and copied MIDI hashes agree; receipt retains all 124 note-on/off pairs, stored tempo policy, master level100, no synthetic final note-offs, sole omitted FF20 metadata, finite output and zero final active voices. Reviewed original-gate validation in the frozen tool.

measurement_review.clock: hardware[a:b] compared with gain * engine[a-1406:b-1406,0]. round(93 + 44.1 - .035*44100) = -1406; no further renderer-latency shift. The sub-sample convention rounds -1406.4 by +0.4 sample.
measurement_review.gain_policy: Copied note36-only phase-zero calibration; no high-note refit and no listening-player attenuation.
measurement_review.channel: Original mono versus raw renderer left float32 converted to float64 before the frozen gain. Full-file L/R maximum differences are 9.094947017729282e-13 and 3.637978807091713e-12 for LP12/LP24. No stereo averaging or per-window normalization.
measurement_review.support: Five fixed3528-sample windows per slope: 91+.10, 91+.16, 93+.10, 88+.10, 86+.10. Every sample hash and -1406 offset verified. The two note91 windows overlap882samples; none is blind validation.
measurement_review.harmonics: Fixed nominal MIDI frequencies and previously audited quadrature/quadratic-ramp estimator. H2-H8/H1 magnitude ratios measure shape; they are kept separate from unaligned raw fixed-phase error power.
measurement_review.alias_masks: Unchanged original-LP12 line IDs9/9/8/11/13 across both slopes. LP24 hardware validity is retained independently and all50 inherited LP24 IDs pass. All100 engine observations remain even when they fail the original threshold. Complete-mask statistics are explicitly search-maximum proxies, not certified resolved-alias errors.
measurement_review.alias_threshold: Interior local maximum within +/-6Hz, at least12dB local prominence and -75dBc, away from harmonics by more than37.5Hz. All saved validity flags and signed/aggregate arithmetic verified.
measurement_review.fixed_phase_residual: Recomputed ten raw and mean-removed relative power residuals from exact PCM with frozen gains. These values cannot rank against phase/DC/gain-fitted oscillator-only residuals and do not directly represent audible mismatch.

interpretation: Report and figure correctly document a substantial full-engine harmonic mismatch with both alias excesses and deficits. The minimum retained-engine baseline is established; this does not justify a particular W4 implementation, identify the oscillator/capture path, prove an internal44.1kHz rate, or establish whole-instrument equivalence.
limitations: Reconstructed physical recipe rather than authenticated original SysEx.
Unknown capture transfer, initial phase and finite-window dynamics remain.
No current-binary rerender, new spectral remeasurement, new optimizer or broad regression run was performed in this review.
Historical original-audio masks and estimator dependencies were verified; this review does not independently re-identify every folded spectral component.
